title: 17th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/17/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 12/2/2025 to 14/2/2025).

First reading of a resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim, seeking members' views on the prolonged, unresolved problems arising from the K-Park Residence housing project started in Hulhumalé.
Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim on the unresolved problems of the K-Park Residence housing project in Hulhumalé.

Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on the President's request to extend the term of Children's Ombudsperson Niumath Shafeeq, under Article 117 of Law No. 19/2019 (Child Rights Protection Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, introduce and begin debating a resolution on the stalled K-Park Residence housing project in Hulhumalé, and take up a committee report on extending the Children's Ombudsperson's term.
